The '''Reformation Act''' was a major piece of legislation passed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as part of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. It apparently dealt with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] demilitarization.
